workspace_proof.submit: Exact execution/submit.hpp eager path builds RuntimeWorkspaceHandle, sets original Runtime stream and calls OpsKey::Call. acquire_workspace allocates Runtime Memory and returns aliasing shared_ptr<void>. It is not a stack raw buffer.
workspace_proof.call: Exact Ops operator.h Call obtains cached op, queries required bytes, acquires local WorkspaceLease, clones invocation handle, binds lease pointer/size, invokes op and holds lease through submission. Cached clone retains fields, not Runtime callback.
workspace_proof.runtime: Exact Runtime::allocateMemory Memory deleter captures shared Runtime. Owner-thread release returns allocation to ReusableMemoryPool without synchronizing. Public pool contract explicitly requires ordered reuse/deallocation on its owned ordinary stream; Runtime stream is borrowed from that pool. Foreign-thread release synchronizes first. No new stream/join introduced.
workspace_proof.gemm: I8Gemm0 caller workspace = align256(M*Nout*4)+4MiB. INT32 accumulator offset0 is written by vendor GEMM and last read by same-stream Epilogue. Trailing4MiB is BLAS workspace used by that GEMM. Same stream serializes subsequent reuse after both submissions. No requirement to retain 502 independent workspaces to final drain.
workspace_proof.handle: Cached I8Gemm operator strongly owns HygonGemmHandle. Acquire uses thread-local weak registry keyed device/context; get checks worker thread and context. Every invocation resets stream, workspace, pointer/math modes. Host-only original bank graph guard retained. No concurrent submission on shared handle is added.
workspace_proof.failure: If GEMM or epilogue submit throws, local workspace lease returns to same stream pool, then original bank catch drains before its owners are destroyed. Outer prefill lease continues retaining earlier banks. No further allocation/reuse before that catch drain is required. Drain failure terminates as original.
workspace_proof.physical_allocator_limit: Exact pool implementation/bucket policy not located in direct current dependency source tree within bounded task; no wider archaeology. Public same-stream safety contract is available. Physical padding and cached allocator occupancy are unknown.
